impact: Original "exits 254 without diagnostics" half resolved: diagnostics added (0961e26), init.mp4 persisted (520e75f). Surviving issue: fMP4 fragments had wrong trun flags (0x0F0100 instead of 0x000705) and compute_moof_size was 100 instead of 104 (tfdt v1 = 20 bytes not 16), causing data_offset to be 108 instead of 112. Source fix applied to fmp4.rs — not yet validated by smoke rerun 20.
resolution: VAL-EXP-001 stream-copy export green in reruns 25/26/27; SHA256 verified; no process leak. trun flags/data_offset, init persistence, and ffmpeg muxer fixes validated end-to-end.
title: VAL-EXP-001: malformed fMP4 trun flags and data_offset cause ffmpeg failure
